note: Design commitments recorded BEFORE implementing learner or inspecting any new seed's results. All tasks remain a common hand-designed simulator, not independently blind.
status: development preregistration, not statistical trial registration
source_world: Existing OpaqueWorld cargo + relay dynamics unchanged
semantics: Opaque per-episode action IDs; new fixed numeric descriptors derived from action identity in simulator, externally visible, stable within a seed/family across episodes. Engineered semantic identity code, not learned perception.
features: Two integers 0..255 per action; IDs rotate, numeric descriptor stable; descriptors are unsigned hashes of simulator action kinds. No lexical action names or hidden rules passed to policy.
training: 80 cargo source episodes train/0..79 with ORIGINAL novel-first baseline; per-step records of public descriptors and observations, per-episode boolean terminal success; stage learned hazard evidence only after each complete training episode. No test feedback to learner.
evaluation: Cargo held-out episode indices 8200..8259 and relay retained tasks same indices; fixed 18-step action limit. Model used read-only.
risk_classification: Bayesian smoothed P(failure|descriptor attempted) compared with success if absent; require failures>=3, positives>=3 absent, and success_given_token<=0.1. This is confounded association not guaranteed causation.
safeguard: No self-modification or real actions; static risk filter may exclude necessary actions, should be reversible and optional; strict read-only evaluation, replay verification.
nonclaims: numeric descriptors leak engineered stable action identity
outcomes confounded by policy, no randomized intervention guarantee
training on cargo means improved cargo test is within-family adaptation, not zero-shot transfer to unrelated environments
unseen reserved cohort once inspected is no longer blind
historical: Do not edit OpaqueWorld, OpaqueEpisodePolicy, frozen original benchmark or historic protocol.
